activities.name: Order preparations of surgery in kardex
activities.reason: The activity involves entering structured data (preparation orders) into a digital system (Kardex) based on well-defined rules and stable documentation.

activities.name: Meet patient
activities.reason: The activity involves physical interaction with a patient, which cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Check results
activities.reason: The activity involves reviewing structured data (test results) in a digital system, following well-defined rules, and has predictable interactions with software.

activities.name: Ordain premedication
activities.reason: The activity involves entering structured data (medication orders) into a digital system (Kardex) based on well-defined rules and stable documentation.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_1qztjjo" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />

      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>

      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">

assessedActivities.name: Conduct drug treatment
assessedActivities.reason: The activity involves medical treatment decisions and actions, which require human judgment and cannot be fully automated with RPA as they lack well-defined rules and structured data interactions.

assessedActivities.name: Conduct mobilisation, physiotherapy
assessedActivities.reason: This activity involves physical therapy and patient interaction, which are inherently manual and require human judgment, making it unsuitable for RPA automation.

assessedActivities.name: Conduct weekly round
assessedActivities.reason: The activity involves medical rounds and patient assessments, which require human judgment, creativity, and interaction with patients, making it unsuitable for RPA.

assessedActivities.name: Conduct daily round
assessedActivities.reason: Similar to the weekly round, this activity involves medical assessments and patient interactions, which require human judgment and cannot be automated with RPA.

assessedActivities.name: Treat the wound
assessedActivities.reason: Wound treatment involves medical judgment, physical interaction, and decision-making that cannot be replicated by RPA, which lacks the ability to perform physical tasks.

assessedActivities.name: Remove drainages and threads
assessedActivities.reason: This activity requires physical manipulation and medical judgment, which are beyond the capabilities of RPA.

      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">

activities.name: Create selection list of courses / modules within area of responsibility
activities.reason: The activity involves human decision-making and selection based on responsibility, which requires creativity and interpretation not supported by the model.

activities.name: Mark courses / modules to be evaluated
activities.reason: This activity involves human judgment in selecting courses for evaluation, which cannot be automated with RPA as it lacks clear, unambiguous rules.

activities.name: Import of courses to be evaluated into internal database
activities.reason: The activity involves importing data into a system using software, following well-defined rules with structured data and no exceptions, making it fully automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Import of courses to be evaluated into EvaSys
activities.reason: Similar to the internal database import, this activity involves software-based data import with clear rules and structured data, suitable for RPA automation.

activities.name: Create evaluation materials
activities.reason: This activity involves manual creation of physical materials (e.g., forms), which is analog and not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Distribute evaluation forms in course
activities.reason: This activity involves physical distribution of forms in a classroom setting, which is analog and not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Fill out evaluation form
activities.reason: This activity is performed by humans manually filling out forms, which is analog and not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Collect evaluation forms
activities.reason: This activity involves physical collection of forms, which is analog and not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Scan and validate evaluation forms
activities.reason: The activity involves scanning and validating forms using software, following clear rules with structured data, making it suitable for RPA automation.

activities.name: Analysis of evaluation forms
activities.reason: This activity involves software-based analysis of structured data with well-defined rules, making it automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Confirm that evaluation results are available
activities.reason: The activity involves checking system outputs for availability, following clear rules with structured data, making it automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Retrieve evaluation results and clean them
activities.reason: This activity involves retrieving and cleaning data from systems, following well-defined rules with structured data, making it automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Acknowledges results
activities.reason: This activity involves human acknowledgment of results, which is a manual process and not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Explain further procedure to patient
activities.reason: This activity requires human communication and interpretation, which cannot be automated through RPA.

activities.name: Arrange further examinations
activities.reason: The activity is performed by a human using software systems (e.g., scheduling tools) with well-defined rules, structured data, and minimal exceptions, making it suitable for RPA automation.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1slfacu">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_1qztjjo" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
